data.one_liner: Provides CLDR-like translations for language names across 157 locales.
data.what_it_does: Provides localized names for languages using ISO codes across 157 different locales. It uses a single-use mapper design for memory efficiency and supports tree-shakability via dart define flags.
use_when: You need to display localized language names in your UI.
You want dependency-free language translations with support for multiple locales and fallbacks.
avoid_when: You need general app localization or asset string translation (use intl or easy_localization instead).
You need to reuse the same mapper instance across multiple calls.
strengths: Supports 157 locales out of the box.
Lazy initialization and single-use design reduce memory footprint.
weaknesses: Mapper instances are single-use only and cannot be reused after calling localize().

alternatives.name: intl
alternatives.why_pick_it: Standard internationalization and localization support for Flutter and Dart.

alternatives.name: easy_localization
alternatives.why_pick_it: Easy localization handling with JSON, CSV, and translation files.
